title: Paxos lecture (Raft user study)
summary: John Ousterhout's slides-and-voiceover lecture on Paxos, made for the Raft user study comparing how students learn Raft and Paxos. It is a full introduction to the Paxos consensus algorithm.
why: Recommended as a clear, lucid way to learn Paxos and Multi-Paxos, ideally alongside the companion Raft video.

quote.text: The 2 videos do an excellent job of explaining both the Paxos and Raft algorithms and the key differences between them.
